answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16702 Country: SG Title: Assalamualekum Is taking out Blood (10-20 ml) for Annual Health Check up allowed during Ramdhan Fast( Sawm )? Will it make Fast Null - Void or Fast will remain good ? Expecting a Quick Reply JazakAllah Question: Assalamualekum Is taking out Blood (10-20 ml) for Annual Health Check up allowed during Ramdhan Fast( Sawm )? Will it make Fast Null - Void or Fast will remain good ? Expecting a Quick Reply JazakAllah Answer ID: 16702 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1608/1280/L=1430) It is allowable to take out blood for check up if needed during fast, it will not make the fast void and null. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
